(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A computer-implemented method for trading combinations of financial instruments, said method comprising: receiving, during a selected time period, combination orders to trade financial instruments; storing each eligible received combination order, wherein a received combination order is eligible if it satisfies at least one selected condition, wherein said at least one selected condition includes the necessary condition that all financial instruments specified by the legs of an eligible order are in a set of two or more selected financial instruments, further comprising processing the eligible orders using a specific computer system that executes the combinatorial matching algorithm (CMA), wherein said processing begins at a selected time.

(Cancelled) Claim 13: The method of claim 1, further comprising computer-executable software, transmitted as an information signal, for causing a computer to implement the steps of said method; and a computer-readable medium having computer-executable instructions stored thereon for causing a computer to implement the steps of said method.

(Currently Amended) Claim 23: A computer-based system for trading combinations of financial instruments, said system comprising: a processing unit configured to obtain combination orders to trade financial instruments; and a data structure configured to obtain a matched collection of expanded eligible orders, wherein an obtained order is eligible if it satisfies at least one selected condition, and wherein said at least one selected condition includes the necessary condition that all financial instruments specified by the legs of an eligible order are in a set of two or more selected financial instruments. 

(Currently Amended) Claim 24: The system of claim 23, further comprising a computer-executable functionality that increases, at least in principle, the quality of said matched collection. 

(Currently Amended) Claim 25: The system of claim 23, further comprising a computer-executable functionality that provides additional trading functionality.
